reference_sql:
WITH be14_lines AS (  -- one row per BE-14 order line of 2024, as stored
  SELECT ol.order_line_id, ol.order_id, ol.product_id, ol.quantity, ol.unit_price_eur, ol.promo_id, ol.line_discount_eur
  FROM order_lines ol
  JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = ol.order_id
  JOIN stores s ON s.store_id = o.store_id
  WHERE s.store_code = 'BE-14'
    AND o.order_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2024-01-01' AND o.order_ts < TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01'
),
unique_lines AS (  -- one row per order line, copies removed
  SELECT DISTINCT order_id, product_id, quantity, unit_price_eur, promo_id, line_discount_eur
  FROM be14_lines
)
SELECT (SELECT SUM(quantity) FROM be14_lines) AS units_stored,
       (SELECT SUM(quantity) FROM unique_lines) AS units_unique
alternatives:
WITH line_sets AS (  -- one row per set of matching BE-14 lines of 2024
  SELECT ol.quantity, COUNT(*) AS n_lines
  FROM order_lines ol
  JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = ol.order_id
  JOIN stores s ON s.store_id = o.store_id
  WHERE s.store_code = 'BE-14'
    AND o.order_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2024-01-01' AND o.order_ts < TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01'
  GROUP BY ol.order_id, ol.product_id, ol.quantity, ol.unit_price_eur, ol.promo_id, ol.line_discount_eur
)
SELECT SUM(quantity * n_lines) AS units_stored, SUM(quantity) AS units_unique
FROM line_sets

  JOIN stores s ON s.store_id = o.store_id
  WHERE s.store_code = 'BE-14'
    AND o.order_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2024-01-01' AND o.order_ts < TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01'
),
unique_lines AS (  -- one row per order line, copies removed
  SELECT DISTINCT order_id, product_id, quantity, unit_price_eur, promo_id, line_discount_eur

)
SELECT st.units_stored, un.units_unique
FROM (SELECT SUM(quantity) AS units_stored FROM be14_lines) AS st
CROSS JOIN (SELECT SUM(quantity) AS units_unique FROM unique_lines) AS un

WITH line_sets AS (  -- one row per set of matching BE-14 lines of 2024
  SELECT ol.quantity, COUNT(*) AS n_lines
  FROM order_lines ol
  JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = ol.order_id
  JOIN stores s ON s.store_id = o.store_id
  WHERE s.store_code = 'BE-14'
    AND o.order_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2024-01-01' AND o.order_ts < TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01'
  GROUP BY ol.order_id, ol.product_id, ol.quantity, ol.unit_price_eur, ol.promo_id, ol.line_discount_eur
)
SELECT SUM(quantity * n_lines) AS units_stored, SUM(quantity) AS units_unique
FROM line_sets
other_way.tradeoff: Grouping the matching lines gives both totals from one step, while DISTINCT keeps the copy-free lines as a table you can look at.
